sources.entry: Ech0 - Lightweight federated publishing platform focused on personal idea sharing (documentation in Chinese). (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: Ech0 is a lightweight, self-hosted personal microblog for publishing short posts, links, and media to a personal timeline that others can follow, comment on, and share.
summary.what_it_does: Ech0 provides a personal timeline where you publish short posts, links, and media from a single interface, with Markdown editing and live preview. It supports RSS output, tags, rich link and video cards (Bilibili and YouTube), and attachments for images, audio, and video. Optional features include a built-in comment system with moderation and captcha (embedded gocap), likes and sharing, and an Ech0 Hub that merges timelines from listed instances. Storage can be local or S3-compatible via VireFS, and the project offers snapshot and capsule export/import, automatic backups, a CLI, a TUI, an Open API with webhooks, and an MCP server. The README also describes an AI "Ech0 Copilot" with recap and chat features using vector RAG. Login options include OAuth2/OIDC and passkeys, and the first account becomes Owner.
use_cases: publish short posts and links on my own domain
share ideas with comments from followers
back up and migrate microblog content
host a public or semi-public personal feed
how_to_run: docker run -d --name ech0 -p 6277:6277 -v /opt/ech0/data:/app/data -e JWT_SECRET="Hello Echos" sn0wl1n/ech0:latest
Open the web UI in a browser and register your first account (it becomes Owner).
Grant publishing permission to other accounts if needed, since publishing is restricted to privileged accounts by default.
For Docker Compose, script install, or Helm, see DEPLOYMENT.md.
stack: Go (backend, inferred from CLI and binaries)
notable: Timeline-style publishing aimed at sharing and light social interaction, not a note-taking or knowledge base tool
Portable content capsules that can be imported into another instance or compiled into a static site
Built-in MCP server and scoped access tokens for AI and automation integrations
Ships as self-contained binaries and container images, with ARM and Raspberry Pi support
Ech0 Hub directory that merges timelines from registered public instances
caveats: Publishing is restricted to privileged accounts by default; regular users need explicit permission
Official documentation and FAQ are primarily in Chinese, with QQ group as main community channel
Third-party integrations not officially authorized by Ech0 are outside official support
